verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single overview line saying the platform embeds real-time interactive video together with "messaging" in apps. That suggests some in-session messaging capability, but nothing describes a documented data API, arbitrary payloads or latency. Missing for 10: a documented in-session data/signaling API, evidence that it carries arbitrary data rather than just chat, latency characteristics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, participants exchange low-latency arbitrary data in the session alongside audio and video, with a documented data API

citations.quote: The Vonage Video API platform makes it possible to embed real-time, high-quality interactive video, messaging, screen-sharing, and more into web and mobile apps.
